d: Mohun Bagan Super Giant registered a 2-1 victory over Punjab FC at the Vivekananda Yuba Bharati Krirangan in Kolkata. Alfred Planas gave Punjab FC an early lead in the third minute. Lee Erwin restored parity for Mohun Bagan before Dejan Dražić scored the decisive goal in the 42nd minute. Mohun Bagan held on to their advantage in the second half to secure all three points.
